description: C T1780 | Seat-type abutment sample from CA multi-span box-girder bridge inventory is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Cliff Roblee, California Department of Transportation (dot.ca.gov). This project performs inventory analysis of seat-type abutment sample from CA multi-span box-girder bridge. A workbook was created to provide complete background and supporting materials. It also includes a full description of the sampling processes used. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Seat Abutments; California Bridges; Inventory. Published 2020-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
